units.source_text: 源氏常来探访玉鬘，足迹太频繁了，深恐引起外人讥评。

en.t: Genji often came to visit Tamakazura, but his visits had become so frequent that he deeply feared they would provoke criticism from outsiders.

units.source_text: 他问心有愧，只得暂时止步。

en.t: Feeling guilty in his own heart, he had no choice but to stop going for the time being.

units.source_text: 然而这期间也想出种种理由来，不断地和她通信。

en.t: Even so, during this time he kept inventing various pretexts and continued to exchange letters with her.

units.source_text: 只有这一件事，朝朝暮暮挂在他的心头。

en.t: This one matter alone stayed on his mind morning and evening.

units.source_text: 他想：“我何必做此无聊之事，自讨烦恼呢？

en.t: He thought, Why must I do such a pointless thing and bring trouble on myself?

units.source_text: 欲免除烦恼，而任情行事，索性娶了她，则世人必讥我为轻薄。

en.t: If, in order to escape this torment, I simply followed my feelings and married her outright, people would surely denounce me as frivolous.

units.source_text: 在我咎由自取，在她却甚冤枉。

en.t: For me it would be trouble of my own making, but for her it would be deeply unfair.

units.source_text: 我对她虽有无限爱情，但决不想教她和紫姬并肩，这一点我自己明白知道。

en.t: Although I feel boundless affection for her, I know perfectly well that I would never place her on equal footing with Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 那末，教她和妾媵同列，对她有什么好处呢？

en.t: Then what good would it do her to place her among my concubines?

units.source_text: 我自己固然位尊名重，迥异常人；但教她嫁给我，在我的许多妻妾中忝列末席，在她有何光荣呢？

en.t: It is true that my rank is high and my name carries weight, far beyond ordinary men, but what honor would there be for her in marrying me only to take the lowest place among my many wives and concubines?

units.source_text: 反不如嫁个纳言之类的寻常小吏，倒可受得专心一意的怜爱。”

en.t: It would be better for her to marry some ordinary official, perhaps a counselor, and receive his single-hearted affection.

units.source_text: 他独自筹思，觉得玉鬘十分可怜。

en.t: As he pondered this alone, he felt deeply sorry for Tamakazura.

units.source_text: 因此有时他也作如是想：“索性把她许给了兵部卿亲王或髭黑大将，如何？

en.t: Because of this, he sometimes thought, What if I simply promised her to Prince Hyobukyo or to the General Higekuro?

units.source_text: 让她教夫家迎娶过去，离开了我，也许可使我断绝了念头吧。

en.t: If I let her husband's family take her away and separate her from me, perhaps I could finally cut off these thoughts.

units.source_text: 此法虽甚没趣，却可做得。”

en.t: Though this plan would be terribly unsatisfying, it could still be done.

units.source_text: 然而他来到玉鬘那里，看到了她的姿色，近来更有教琴的借口，则又依依不舍地亲近她。

en.t: Yet when he went to Tamakazura and saw her beauty, and now that he had the further excuse of teaching her the koto, he again drew close to her, unable to tear himself away.
